name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's journey in motorsport began in his teens, tinkering with karts at his local track near Spa-Francorchamps. He quickly developed a keen eye for detail and a knack for identifying performance bottlenecks. After earning a degree in engineering, he worked his way up through the ranks of various racing teams, from junior formula to GT racing, specializing in data analysis and race strategy. His relentless pursuit of efficiency and his ability to motivate his team led to numerous victories and ultimately landed him the role of team principal at Hot Racing Team.

Thierry is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to foster a collaborative environment. He believes in empowering his team members and trusting their expertise, while maintaining a clear vision for the team's goals. His experience across different racing disciplines has equipped him with a broad perspective, allowing him to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and make informed decisions. Thierry is distinguished by his relentless focus on marginal gains, seeking every possible advantage to push his team to the forefront of the competition.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Thierry is of average height, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during races.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Belgian chocolate in the team garage.
